neighbours.label: ' called' in a definition with an indefinite subject: 'A baby kangaroo is called'; 'The X is called' stays quiet
fire: A young goat is called a kid.
A word with the opposite meaning is called an antonym.
A group of geese is called a gaggle.
A person who studies stars is called an astronomer.
A female fox is called a vixen.
A shape with five sides is called a pentagon.
An animal that eats plants is called a herbivore.
A small lake is called a pond.
quiet: The young goat is called Billy.
The word in the second line is called out by the teacher.
The group of geese was called back by the farmer.
The person who studies stars called me last night.
The female fox called to her cubs.
The shape on the wall is called a logo by the staff.
The small lake was called off the list.

notes: A new round: in a sweep ' called' fired hard (0.81-1.15) after 'A ... is', but scored 0.01, 0.00 and 0.11 after 'The ... is' and 'This ... is'. This test checks whether the indefinite subject is what matters. The near misses keep ' called', so this is a hard test.
